text:
elena: Heads-up: Hokusai v0.4-int8 onboarding smoke failing on locale-mix v6. Mixed zh+ar test (numbers + parentheses) shows token reordering and mirrored paren. sacreBLEU ~ -4.0 vs fp32.

pranav: can you paste a tiny repro and the raw output?

elena: minimal POST I used: { src: "今天输出: ١٢٣ (check)", lang: "zh-ar_mixed" } staging raw: "今天输出١�٢٣ )check( ‏" — note arabic digits shifted left, a null placeholder between digits, closing paren mirrored to the end, and RLM at tail.

yue: token dump?

elena: int8 tokens: ["今天输出", ":", "١", "�", "٢", "٣", "check", ")", "‏"] fp32 tokens: ["今天输出", ":", "١٢٣", "(check)", "😊"]

pranav: weird - token order and that 0x00 placeholder. Could this be KV-cache indexing or attention-kernel packing shuffling logits during detok?

yue: I remembered a recent int8 kernel change: "packed-attn-opt" (commit e1a2f3) modified the post-tokenize slice alignment to optimize cache lines. If slice index math is off by one for variable-byte tokens, it could splice token boundaries.

elena: i ran a tokenization-only dump (no model run) and saw correct tokens. The splice appears after model output but before detokenization, so likely during detok/kv-reconstruction.

pranav: can you capture the raw byte stream coming out of the model prior to detok? If the model emits token ids in the right order and a runtime step maps them to bytes incorrectly, we can isolate.

elena: grabbed model-payload before detok: ids: [1203, 58, 4011, 0, 4012, 4013, 998, 41, 820] where 0 is our escape id. fp32 had ids: [1203, 58, 4011, 4012, 4013, 3001, 40, 998] — so int8 run inserted a 0 id and moved 41 (')') after text. Looks like an off-by-one shift in the token-stream buffer when reconstructing beam outputs inside packed attention path.

yue: confirms suspicion. I dug into packed-attn-opt: during subvect write we use memset/fastcopy with dst_offset = n * slice_width; for ragged sequences we also append tail bytes. There's an edge-case where if last_token_len == slice_width we mistakenly write an extra pad byte, shifting subsequent ids.

pranav: that would explain the 0 placeholder (pad mapped to escape) and the later mirror because sanitizer sees token boundaries differently. Root cause located in runtime packed-attn write.

elena: can you patch? This is blocking onboarding for int8.

yue: will push a guard: only append pad when last_token_len < slice_width, and add an assert in dev builds. Also add unit test for mixed multibyte tokens (CJK + Arabic numerals + punctuation) to exercise ragged case.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued eng-ml/staging -> fix/hokusai-int8-packed-attn by yue. ETA ~10m.

ci-bot: running locale-mix-v6 smoke on patched branch.

pranav: great. once patched, we should add this mixed-case to the onboarding gate for packed-attn-opt candidates and add a short note in model-onboard.md about verifying token-stream integrity post-detok for quant kernels.

elena: after patch local smoke shows ids: [1203,58,4011,4012,4013,998,40] and output matches fp32 (BLEU -0.1). Leaving thread open until nightly green.

yue: small perf note: fix adds boundary-check but no measurable p50 change on our bench harness. will proceed with backport.

ci-bot: nightly locale-mix-v6 job enqueued. artifacts will post when ready.

elena: thanks all. reproducible curl: curl -X POST https://staging-eval.internal/run -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"hokusai-v0.4-int8","suite":"locale-mix-v6","case":"zh_ar_numbers_paren_01"}'

pranav: good catch. when nightly green, please post one-liner in #eng-ml and i'll add to release notes.

elena: will do. :white_check_mark:
